name: LINE 群組任務與行事曆統一關鍵詞
requiresEnv: Existing LINE group task service and DailyLog
definitionOfDone: Native mentions followed by 任務, 活動 or 會議 are the only new group-create commands
Undated tasks preserve source-time plus 48 hours; dated tasks retain execution-day plus two days
Missing calendar details require organizer supplementation; default duration is one hour
Current identity, permission, source withdrawal, receipts and historical pending-work safeguards pass affected regression tests
Reviewed main commit and the latest complete Worker are deployed and read back
